name: Password Policy for Password Reset Landing Page (PRLP)
description: Allows Password Policy to work with the Password Reset Landing Page module.
project_description:
Various additions and enhancements to the Password Policy module.

 Features 
 
 Auto-refresh of the password validation status table while typing. 
 Option to only display the failed rules messages instead of the whole 3 columns table (check screenshot) . 
 Various accessibility improvements and fixes. 
 Integration with user_registrationpassword module (via submodule) . 
 Integration with Password Reset Landing Page (prlp) module (via submodule) . 
 
 This project aims to be a sandbox for the Password Policy module.

 We will try to keep in sync with password_policy versioning, at least for the major version.

 A dedicated submodule makes password_policy compatible with the user_registrationpassword module.

 Another dedicated submodule makes password_policy compatible with the Password Reset Landing Page (prlp) module (version 8.x-1.11+ required).
